notes: Printed: '{2}: Add one mana of any color.' THIS PACK PINS A SCAFFOLD, NOT THE PRINTED TEXT. Mana abilities are no menu rows (2026-11-11): a game activates one only while a cost is paid, the payer choosing the source and its colour (CR 605.3a), so the pack pays through a cast with "tap": true or the menu (act). The payer never pays a mana cost of a mana ability (BACKLOG 'Automatic payment': the filters are given up; test_executor_legality's priced-mana-ability test lists Prismite), so in a game Prismite's filter never makes mana: with {C}{C} in the pool, Skyway Sniper's {G} cannot be paid. The day the payer pays filters this pack fails: rewrite it to the printed text (the {C}{C} become {G}, the Sniper enters). Until 2026-11-17 it activated the filter directly, a path no game takes.
